## Goal
- Build and deploy IVX IA as a **fully owner-controlled AI engineering platform** that can operate, code, test, commit, deploy, monitor, and recover WITHOUT Rork — execute end-to-end, not return only a plan; remove all Rork dependencies from the normal development path; verify and sync all credentials live; **rebuild IVX Owner AI as a REAL senior developer that never reports false completion**

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_LANDING_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION
- No fake data, no placeholder progress — honest about what can/cannot be done from inside Rork sandbox
- Owner demands honest senior-developer audit — NOT narrative claims; wants real end-to-end proof
- Owner demands Senior Developer answer format: structured TASK ID / STATUS / FILES CHANGED / COMMANDS / TESTS / DEPLOYED proof — NOT product-support summaries
- **CRITICAL**: DEPLOYED ≠ VERIFIED; a CODE_FIX/UI_FIX/FEATURE task with no code change is NOT complete
- **CRITICAL SECURITY**: never display/log/store passwords in screenshots, logs, analytics, alerts, proof reports; redact as ********; never hardcode passwords; never bypass Supabase auth
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — use Python `gzip.compress()` + `base64.b64encode()`; repo-root relative paths
- **Rork sandbox `git push` goes to Rork git router, NOT canonical GitHub** — must use owner-gated `github_commit_file` API to push to canonical repo
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Render restart API: `{action: "render_restart_service", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE"}`
- Render update source: `{action: "render_update_source", input: {branch: "main", commitSha}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE"}` — forces specific commit
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at.json` (JSON with `accessToken` field); re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; token expires ~1h; **can refresh via Supabase `POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=refresh_token` with anon key + refreshToken**
- APK/landing presign upload API: `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD" or "CONFIRM_IVX_LANDING_UPLOAD"}` — returns `uploadUrl` (S3 presigned PUT) + `publicUrl`; then PUT the file to `uploadUrl`
- Landing upload whitelist pattern: `^(index\.html|reset-password\.html|robots\.txt|sitemap\.xml|ivx-[a-z0-9-]{1,60}\.(js|json)|landing-support-chat\.(js|css))$`
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Health endpoint: `GET https://api.ivxholding.com/health` returns `{commit, status}` — use to verify deploy propagation
- `bun test backend/` = 1709 pass / 0 fail (6230 expects)
- Bash commands must complete under 60s or timeout; Render propagation ~2-4 min; use nohup background + poll for long ops
- Clean sandbox has NO `node_modules` — must run `bun install` before tests or tsc
- `watchman` disabled to prevent Metro/Gradle build hangs
- MFA must be optional, OFF by default

## Progress
### Done
- **CERTIFICATION FIX — DEFECT 1 & 2 — FIXED, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, LIVE-VERIFIED**
  - Commits: `83cd9efdf9ec` + `ebbdc7c52d42` + `11b323a86aba` + `ada4bddd4846` + `2efbffcc15e3`
  - 11 routing + QA regression tests all passing

- **ENTERPRISE AUTH RECOVERY — PHASES 1-17 — CODE-LEVEL COMPLETE (~70% VERIFIED)**
  - Phase 1-4: Security freeze, Supabase project match, owner audit, password invalidation + session revocation
  - Phase 5: Password policy 12-char min — commit `9863d7b01187`
  - Phase 6: Login trace IDs — commit `35c42edc61dd`
  - Phase 7-11: Auth conflicts audit, MFA verified OFF by default
  - Phase 15: 32/32 enterprise auth tests pass (94 expects)
  - Phase 17: Production proof report delivered
  - APK v1.4.27(59) + v1.4.28(60) — BUILT, UPLOADED, LIVE-VERIFIED

- **FORGOT PASSWORD 429 RATE-LIMIT HANDLING — FIXED, DEPLOYED**
  - `expo/app/forgot-password.tsx` detects 429 `over_email_send_rate_limit` and shows user-friendly wait message
  - Commit: `ecad2525ce39`

- **BACKEND SES PASSWORD RESET FALLBACK — BUILT, DEPLOYED, LIVE**
  - Action `send_owner_password_reset_email_via_ses` generates Supabase recovery link via admin REST API and sends via Amazon SES

- **AWS SES IDENTITY VERIFICATION ACTIONS — BUILT, DEPLOYED, LIVE**
  - `verify_ses_email_identity` and `list_ses_identities` actions
  - Verified identities: `ivxholding.com`, `osconstructors@gmail.com`, `noreply@ivxholding.com`
  - `iperez4242@gmail.com` verification email sent but NOT confirmed by owner

- **`generate_owner_password_reset_link` ACTION — BUILT, DEPLOYED, LIVE**
  - Returns Supabase reset link directly in API response — bypasses email delivery
  - Now includes `replaceRedirectUrlInSupabaseActionLink()` to rewrite `redirect_to` param

- **SUPABASE `uri_allow_list` FIX — DEPLOYED, LIVE-VERIFIED**
  - Backend now patches `uri_allow_list` (space-separated string) instead of `redirect_urls` (array)
  - Also sets `site_url` to `https://ivxholding.com`
  - Commit `18628111a57a` — deployed and live
  - `uri_allow_list` now contains `https://ivxholding.com/reset-password`

- **LINK REDIRECT REWRITE FIX — DEPLOYED, LIVE-VERIFIED**
  - Added `replaceRedirectUrlInSupabaseActionLink()` to force `redirect_to` to correct URL in generated links
  - Commit `ae73a6590abe` — deployed and live
  - Generated link confirmed: `redirect_to=https%3A%2F%2Fivxholding.com%2Freset-password`

### In Progress
- **RESET-PASSWORD LANDING PAGE — CODE COMPLETE, GITHUB PUSHED, DEPLOYING**
  - **ROOT CAUSE FOUND**: Reset link redirected to `https://ivxholding.com` homepage because `/reset-password` is an Expo app route only — S3 static site has no such page, so CloudFront serves `index.html`
  - Created `expo/ivxholding-landing/reset-password.html` — real web-based reset page with Supabase client-side auth, password validation, show/hide toggles, deep link back to app
  - Updated landing upload whitelist in `backend/api/ivx-apk-distribution.ts` to allow `reset-password.html`
  - Changed default redirect URL from `https://ivxholding.com/reset-password` to `https://ivxholding.com/reset-password.html` across all files
  - 7 files pushed to GitHub via owner-gated commit API (final commit `1d431ef25bed`)
  - Backend deploying — Render cycling through commits (current runtime `010d621332e3`, target `1d431ef25bed`)
  - **S3 upload of reset-password.html failed with 400** — presign endpoint rejected `reset-password.html` key because runtime is on intermediate commit that may not have whitelist update yet
  - Need to wait for backend to reach commit `1d431ef25bed` then retry presign upload

### Blocked
- **OWNER CANNOT SIGN IN** — old password invalidated; reset email not arriving due to:
  1. Supabase 429 rate limit (primary) — every `/recover` call rejected
  2. AWS SES sandbox mode — `iperez4242@gmail.com` identity pending verification (owner must click AWS verification email link)
  3. **Reset link redirects to homepage** — `/reset-password` not a web page on S3 static site (fix in progress: `reset-password.html` landing page)
- **S3 upload of reset-password.html blocked** — backend runtime not yet on commit with whitelist update (`reset-password.html` added to `IVX_LANDING_KEY_PATTERN`)
- 34 system-managed history files contain exposed password (read-only, outside sandbox write scope)

## Key Decisions
- Changed redirect URL from `/reset-password` to `/reset-password.html` because S3 static hosting needs an actual file — Expo app routes don't exist on the web
- Built reset-password as a self-contained HTML page with client-side Supabase JS (CDN) + runtime config discovery via `/ivx-config.json` — avoids needing backend rendering
- Used owner-gated `github_commit_file` API instead of `git push` because Rork sandbox push goes to Rork git router, not canonical GitHub repo
- Token refresh via Supabase `POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=refresh_token` is the reliable way to unblock 401 errors on deploy APIs

## Next Steps
1. Wait for backend runtime to reach commit `1d431ef25bed` (poll `/health`)
2. Retry S3 presign upload of `reset-password.html` — mint presigned URL then PUT the file
3. Verify `https://ivxholding.com/reset-password.html` serves the HTML page (not homepage)
4. Update Supabase `uri_allow_list` to include `https://ivxholding.com/reset-password.html`
5. Generate fresh verified reset link with `redirect_to=https://ivxholding.com/reset-password.html`
6. Test the full flow: tap link → reset-password.html loads → exchange code → set new password → confirm
7. Provide owner with the working link
